newsitem.title: USA: Mastech in year 2000 pact with FPL unit.
newsitem.headline: Mastech in year 2000 pact with FPL unit.

text.p: Mastech Corp said Thursday it had been awarded a contract to perform a Year 2000 conversion project for Florida Power and Light, the utility subsidiary of FPL Group Inc.
Terms of the pact were not disclosed.
During the 18-month project, Mastech will provide impact analysis, renovation and testing for the mainframe systems of FPL against the so-called "millennium bug."

Many older computers and software programs, unable to process two-digit dates correctly after December 31, 1999, could crash on January 1, 2000, while many other will think the date is Jauary 1, 1900.
Many companies must hire other firms to mine through millions of lines of code to correct the problem.
Mastech said it will utilize Viasoft Inc's software on the project.
